features.text: Elastic knee orthosis with joints, prefabricated, off-the-shelf for effective stabilization.

features.label: Customizable Fit Options
features.text: Choose the pull-on sleeve for a streamlined fit or the wraparound design for adjustable compression, perfect for wider thighs or calves.

features.label: Extended Sizing
features.text: Available in sizes 2XS to 2XL, offering a solution for both petite and larger body types.

features.label: Patellar Stabilization
features.text: Lateral buttress prevents misalignment and improves patellar tracking during movement.

features.label: Breathable Comfort
features.text: Lightweight material wicks away moisture, keeping your knee cool and comfortable throughout activities.

features.label: Non-Slip Design
features.text: Silicone strips and elastic banding ensure the brace stays securely in place during intense workouts or sports.
